# spaceman message

Durable messages between agents, control and operators: list, show, send, reply, ack and resolve (--space).

Aliases: `messages`, `msg`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman message ack`](#spaceman-message-ack) | Acknowledge a message addressed to operators |
| [`spaceman message get`](#spaceman-message-get) | Show a message |
| [`spaceman message list`](#spaceman-message-list) | A space's recent messages |
| [`spaceman message reply`](#spaceman-message-reply) | Reply to an agent's message (a reply to a request resolves it) |
| [`spaceman message resolve`](#spaceman-message-resolve) | Close a message or request |
| [`spaceman message send`](#spaceman-message-send) | Send a message to control, a role or a run |

## spaceman message ack

Acknowledge a message addressed to operators.

```sh
spaceman message ack <message> [flags]
```

API: `ack-message` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman message get

Show a message.

```sh

```

API: `get-message` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman message list

A space's recent messages.

```sh
spaceman message list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-messages` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer |  | maximum number of items |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman message reply

Reply to an agent's message (a reply to a request resolves it).

```sh
spaceman message reply <message> [flags]
```

API: `reply-message` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string |  | reply (required) |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman message resolve

Close a message or request.

```sh
spaceman message resolve <message> [flags]
```

API: `resolve-message` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--resolution` | string |  | how it was resolved |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman message send

Send a message to control, a role or a run.

```sh
spaceman message send [flags]
```

API: `send-message` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman message send --space payments --to role:worker --subject "Freeze deploys" --body-file freeze.md --request
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string |  | body (Markdown) |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--correlation-id` | string |  | correlation ID |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--request` | bool |  | expect a reply |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--subject` | string |  | subject (required) |
| `--to` | string |  | control, role:NAME or run:RUN-ID (required) |
